summary: ONE Gas, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on May 4, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 earnings results, reaffirming 2026 financial guidance, and declaring a $0.68 per share quarterly dividend payable June 2, 2026 to holders of record May 18, 2026. The filing includes a press release and cover XBRL. This is a routine quarterly earnings and dividend announcement; no special-situation M&A, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The registrant is the issuer/filer. The dividend is part of ordinary course capital allocation. No risk-arb angle or event-driven catalyst exists.
